snippet.title: The Hero Of Pixel Spire DEMO Release - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Ascend a Tower of Chaos. Upgrade spells that evolve wildly. Survive savage bosses. Rescue other Ascendents. Will you become the Hero Of Pixel Spire?

Unleash powerful spells, dodge intense bullet-hell attacks, and defeat formidable bosses in this action-packed rogue-lite RPG. Customize your hero with Pets, Perks, Classes, Cosmetics and MORE!

Created in 3 years by a small 3 person indie dev team.
Try the Demo today and Wishlist on Steam to support the Game!
